name: markdown-cpp-preview
description: Render Markdown files as local HTML previews with syntax highlighting for C++ code blocks.

interface.shortDescription: Preview Markdown with highlighted C++ code.
interface.longDescription: Creates a local HTML preview for Markdown files and highlights fenced C++ code blocks without changing the source Markdown.
interface.defaultPrompt: Render this Markdown file as a local HTML preview with C++ syntax highlighting.
